title: Homogeneous multiplication adds degrees.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $\mathcal A$ be a quasi-coherent commutative $\mathcal O_X$-algebra sheaf [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra] [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf]. Let $(B_n)_{n\in\mathbb N}$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules equipped with a commutative unital graded sheaf algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], with multiplication maps $\mu_{m,n}(U):\Gamma(U,B_m)\times\Gamma(U,B_n)\to\Gamma(U,B_{m+n})$ for every open $U\subseteq X$. Suppose a specified isomorphism of underlying module sheaves $d:\bigoplus_{n\ge0}B_n\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal A$ respects the multiplication and the unit. Write $i_n:B_n\to\mathcal A$ for its composite with the $n$th coproduct inclusion; multiplicativity means $i_{m+n}(U)(\mu_{m,n}(U)(x,y))=i_m(U)(x)\cdot i_n(U)(y)$ in $\Gamma(U,\mathcal A)$ for every open $U\subseteq X$, all $m,n\in\mathbb N$, $x\in\Gamma(U,B_m)$ and $y\in\Gamma(U,B_n)$. For an affine open $V\subseteq X$, put $C_V=\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)$ and define the additive subgroup $C_{V,n}=\operatorname{im}(i_n(V):\Gamma(V,B_n)\to C_V)$. Then for all $m,n\in\mathbb N$ and $a,b\in C_V$ with $a\in C_{V,m}$ and $b\in C_{V,n}$ one has $ab\in C_{V,m+n}$. These are the section ring and image subgroups denoted by $A.\mathrm{sections}(V)$ and $A.\mathrm{sectionGrade}(V,n)$ for the given relative Proj input algebra $A$.
